name: confbox
reason: Not counted: copy of the selected parser behind a thin wrapper. confbox 0.3.2 parseYAML(text) strips a BOM, calls load() from dist/_chunks/libs/js-yaml.mjs and records indentation for stringifyYAML. That chunk is a rolldown-minified copy of js-yaml 5.x built from its js-yaml ^5.5.0 devDependency (THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES lists js-yaml): all 195 property names in the chunk occur in js-yaml 5.5.0 dist/js-yaml.mjs, and the 5.x-only identifiers implicitFirstChars, matchByTagPrefix and representTagName occur 21, 13 and 7 times, exactly as in js-yaml 5.5.0 and never in js-yaml 4.1.1. Both controls match the oracle in an exploratory run, but the whole parse is the selected js-yaml code (fgergo/mp3 byte-identical-fork precedent; the thin JSON.parse wrappers of the JavaScript JSON cell are likewise not counted). The integrator may instead count it as a labelled wrapper.

name: @zkochan/js-yaml
reason: Not counted: fork of a superseded js-yaml release. 0.0.11 lib/ is js-yaml 4.1.0 lib/ plus a prototype-safe setProperty in loader.js and dumper options (SINGLE_LINE_KEYS, blankLines); 1,259 of its 1,274 distinct non-test, non-dumper source lines equal js-yaml 4.1.0, and 110 occur in the selected js-yaml 5.5.0 dist/js-yaml.cjs.js, whose loader 5.x rewrote. Predecessor-version rule (zend-json, trust-dns-proto precedents). Not run.

name: read-yaml-file
reason: Not counted: thin file wrapper over a superseded js-yaml release. 3.0.0 index.js is fs.readFile + strip-bom + yaml.load from its js-yaml ^4.1.1 dependency, so every parse step runs in js-yaml 4.1.1, a predecessor release of the selected js-yaml 5.5.0 (4.1.1 lib/ shares 110 of 1,274 distinct lines with 5.5.0). Predecessor-version rule; also a thin wrapper like the JSON.parse wrappers left uncounted in the JavaScript JSON cell. Not run.

name: @lezer/yaml
reason: Not a document parser under the YAML protocol: the Lezer LR grammar for CodeMirror returns a syntax tree of node types and source ranges, without scalar values, escape decoding, block-scalar folding or alias resolution, so the harness would have to interpret YAML itself. Not run.

name: @stoplight/yaml-ast-parser
reason: Not counted as its own path: near-identical fork of the selected yaml-ast-parser 0.0.43. 0.0.50 dist/src shares 1,364 of its 1,447 distinct non-test source lines with yaml-ast-parser 0.0.43; the changes add comment collection (readComment) and small int/float inference edits in scalarInference.ts and type/int.ts, type/float.ts.
